# loops — autonomous cycles

> Every loop must have a stopping condition and a verification step per
> iteration. A loop without a verify step is a way to burn tokens, not work.

## Choosing a part

| Situation | Part |
|---|---|
| Run a bounded repeating cycle from a user prompt | `parts/loop/` |
| Unattended / night shift / heartbeat: one task polished at a time | `parts/autonomous-work/` |
| Ready-made loop prompt patterns to pick from | `parts/loop-library/` |

## Rules

- Bounded by default: max iterations and a stop condition come from the
  owner's invocation, never invented.
- Each iteration ends with verification and a written finding — not silence.
- Destructive or irreversible actions inside a loop always pause for the
  owner; autonomy never outranks Never Destroy.
- One-off persona/style modes (`godmode`, `bro`) are separate top-level
  skills, not loops.
